sensors.description: Bearing housing temperature from the condition-monitoring module.
Overall bearing vibration velocity from the condition-monitoring module.
Lubricant particle count from the condition-monitoring module.
Discharge pressure from the hydraulic I/O card.
Discharge flow from the hydraulic I/O card.
Control valve position feedback from the hydraulic I/O card.
Motor current reported by the drive.
Shaft speed reported by the drive.

constraints.rule: Channels on one acquisition module or I/O card may fail together; other combinations are not tested.
Faults on different channels are independent corruptions of clean readings; same-channel overlap is not modeled.
Bearing temperature, vibration and particle count share one condition-monitoring module.
Particle counts saturate or stop rather than drift.
Pressure, flow and valve feedback share one hydraulic I/O card; drift is capped at 2 SD.
Drive-reported current and speed fail together on a drive communication fault; speed does not drift.
The ambient reference is only combined with bearing temperature and is not drift-tested.
Constant nameplate channels are excluded because corrupting them changes no readings.
